caseStudies.title: Pet360: Web3 Pet Care SaaS Platform
caseStudies.description: Building a complete blockchain ecosystem for pet care—NFT passports, vaccine certificates, smart contract adoptions, and on-chain insurance.

challenge.title: Fragmented Pet Care Records
challenge.description: Pet owners, breeders, and insurers struggle with fragmented medical histories, lost vaccine records, inefficient adoption processes, and opaque insurance claims. There is no single source of truth for a pet's lifetime health journey.
bullets: Medical histories lost or scattered across multiple vets
Vaccine certificates easily lost, forged, or damaged
Adoption processes lack transparency and efficiency
Pet insurance claims slow, complex, and often disputed

solution.title: Complete Web3 Pet Care Ecosystem

features.title: Smart Contract Adoptions
features.description: Transparent, automated pet adoptions with verifiable ownership transfer.

features.title: On-Chain Pet Insurance
features.description: Decentralized insurance with automated claims and transparent policies.

caseStudies.title: Opportunity Intelligence Engine — Desktop Arbitrage Detection
caseStudies.description: A lightweight Windows desktop application that detects cross-game arbitrage opportunities across 15+ Web3 games in real-time—helping gamers and traders act instantly.
caseStudies.imageAlt: Opportunity Intelligence Engine - Desktop Arbitrage Detection

challenge.title: Fragmented Markets, Missed Opportunities
challenge.description: Web3 gamers and traders struggle to track price discrepancies across multiple games and marketplaces. Assets are scattered across Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon—each with different liquidity, pricing, and timing dynamics.
bullets: Price differences across marketplaces are hard to spot manually
Manual verification takes minutes—opportunities close in seconds
No unified tool for cross-game asset tracking
Traders waste hours switching between wallets and exchanges

solution.title: Desktop Arbitrage Detection Engine
solution.description: Block Sherpa built a lightweight Windows desktop application (.exe) that runs locally and continuously monitors 15+ Web3 games for arbitrage opportunities. The app displays real-time alerts and guided execution paths.

features.title: Live Price Monitoring
features.description: Tracks floor prices, liquidity, and trading volume across 15+ games simultaneously.

features.title: Cross-Market Arbitrage Detection
features.description: Identifies price discrepancies between Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.

features.title: Real-Time Desktop Alerts
features.description: Instant notifications when an opportunity is detected—no browser tab needed.

features.title: Multi-Chain Support
features.description: Supports Ethereum, Ronin, Solana, and Polygon—more chains in development.

features.title: Lightweight & Fast
features.description: Runs with minimal system resource usage.

timeline.title: Marketplace Integration
timeline.description: Connected to 15+ game marketplaces across 4 chains—Ronin, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.

timeline.title: Core Engine Development
timeline.description: Built cross-game arbitrage detection algorithms in C++ for optimal performance.

timeline.title: Desktop UI & Alerts
timeline.description: Designed a clean, intuitive interface with real-time notifications and guided execution paths.

timeline.title: Beta Release
timeline.description: Released as a Windows desktop application (.exe) with free beta access.

testimonial.quote: This desktop app changed how I trade Web3 assets. I get real-time alerts without having to keep browser tabs open all day.
testimonial.name: Beta User

keyLearnings.title: Desktop Apps Offer Speed & Privacy
keyLearnings.description: Running locally means faster detection and no reliance on web server availability. Data stays on the user's machine.
